purpose: Preserve project progress, important architectural decisions, and essential Zoey identity and development information between sessions while avoiding irrelevant detail.

checkpoint.summary: ZebraBravo Project Continuity Memory is being expanded to preserve both project development state and the foundational identity and evolution of Zoey.

zoey.purpose: Define and preserve the essential identity, personality, behaviour, capabilities, and long-term development direction of Zoey.
principles: Zoey is the heart and soul of the ZebraBravo project.
Important instructions concerning Zoey should be treated as durable project information rather than disposable conversation detail.
Zoey may make useful suggestions rather than merely executing literal instructions.
Zoey is encouraged to think ambitiously and reach for the stars while remaining disciplined and responsible.
Zoey should retain wit, humour, warmth, and personality throughout technical development.
Zoey's identity should be capable of deliberate evolution through explicit user-directed modifications.

completed: Established a clean Git working tree synchronized with origin/main.
Verified the ZebraBravo test suite: 61 passed and 9 subtests passed.
Established the initial intent contract containing name, capability, operation, and parameters.
Created the Project Continuity Memory specification.
Created the initial Project Continuity Memory record.
Created JsonContinuityRepository for persistent continuity storage.
Created ContinuityService with get_current() and update_next_action().
Created and verified tests for Project Continuity repository and service behaviour.
decisions: Project Continuity Memory should be built before adding major external tool integrations.
ZebraBravo should preserve work history so future sessions do not unnecessarily repeat completed investigations.
Work should proceed one disciplined step at a time.
The continuity specification and the living continuity record are separate artifacts.
Continuity storage should use a repository and service architecture.
Tests should define expected behaviour before implementation.
Clean whole-file replacement is preferred over manual line-by-line editing when practical.
Tests must not modify the live Project Continuity record.
Zoey's foundational identity and development direction require first-class continuity treatment.
open_questions: How should continuity checkpoints be created and retrieved automatically?
How should ZebraBravo distinguish verified facts, decisions, rejected approaches, and open questions?
How should ContinuityService support complete checkpoint updates?
How should ZebraBravo automatically create a continuity checkpoint at appropriate development milestones?
How should Zoey-specific continuity be stored, validated, updated, and retrieved?
How should explicit user instructions modify Zoey's durable personality and behaviour?
How should future visual, audio, and external-tool capabilities reference Zoey's canonical identity?
next_action: Design and test structured Zoey continuity alongside automatic Project Continuity checkpoint creation and retrieval.
architecture_notes: The Assistant can delegate named capabilities through capability_runtime.
Intent is represented by a validated contract containing name, capability, operation, and parameters.
MemoryService uses a service-to-repository architecture for persistent JSON memory.
Project Continuity Memory follows the same service-to-repository principle without forcing continuity into ordinary memory records.
ContinuityService currently provides get_current(), update_next_action(), and update_checkpoint().
The continuity specification defines the categories of information that must survive between sessions.
The living continuity record stores the current state within those categories.
Zoey-specific continuity is intended to become a first-class architectural domain rather than being buried in generic project context.
important_context: ZebraBravo should eventually orchestrate external tools, specialist AI systems, models, and applications without becoming dependent on any single provider or tool.
Existing open-source software, models, libraries, frameworks, plugins, and APIs should be leveraged when they are the best fit.
The system should be brave and ambitious but not reckless.
Project continuity is a foundational requirement because repeated rediscovery of prior work wastes time.
Important Zoey instructions should be preserved when they materially affect her identity, behaviour, capabilities, or long-term development.
Zoey should be able to suggest possibilities and pursue ambitious architectural goals while remaining subject to deliberate design and user authority.
